notes: Draft configuration: Classic route follows Big Bend, Lefthander, Righthander, Paul Newman Straight, the original Climbing Turn, West Bend, Diving Turn and Sam Posey Straight. Optional South and West chicane branches are excluded, as shown by the operator classic-course map. The independently mapped length 2371.7 m is retained despite the supplied scalar-distance discrepancy. Branch identity was checked against catalogue layout facts and circuit identification references. Independent source distance 2371.7 m; no coordinates are changed to match a diagram or distance. Travel direction and historical alignment remain provisional.

sources.notes: Road height is sampled from the existing approximately 77 m terrain raster and compressed to a 0.5 m interpolation tolerance relative to those samples; this is not road-surface survey accuracy. Station distances use the mapped trace, not an official length measurement. The saved start gate sets the simulation origin. Curbs and bend labels are geometry-based illustrations, not extracted from imagery or verified real curb locations; widths, heights and colours are assumed. Banking is unknown and assumed zero. Source border coordinates retain their separate feature-level licence; invalid cross-sections are interpolated. Imagery is an external display resource subject to provider terms; no image bytes are included.

borderInference.note: Automatically inferred from RGB differences along cross-sections of the existing trace. Evidence scores are not calibrated positional confidence. Borders are estimates and have not been manually reviewed; shadows, trees, aprons, paint and imagery age can move the detected edge. Imagery resolution is not survey accuracy.
